headword: {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}

definitions.explanation: A planned area where factories and related facilities are gathered together, typically developed with shared infrastructure such as roads and utilities.

examples.japanese: {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: to build a factory in an industrial park

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{造成|ぞうせい}→造成：16756_zousei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The city developed an industrial park in the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {工業団地|こうぎょうだんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: Many companies have gathered in the industrial park, supporting local employment.

notes:
A developed zone where industrial plants are concentrated. Built from ⟦{工業|こうぎょう}→工業：01402_kougyou⟧ (industry) and ⟦{団地|だんち}→団地：04054_danchi⟧ (a planned cluster of buildings or housing).
